name: Northstar IT Request Agent flow
purpose: Conversational entry point for the existing Northstar IT service-request business process.
steps: Normalize and validate the four agent inputs
SharePoint Create item in the existing Northstar / IT Service Requests list
SharePoint Update item with concat('SR-', formatNumber(Create item ID, '000'))
Microsoft Teams Post card in a chat or channel using the existing request card shape

resourcePolicy.formsFlowName: Northstar IT Service Request - Inspect Response

verification.requiredEvidence: Copilot Studio Preview or a controlled Teams channel showing the Agent flow run, returned request ID, status, and downstream activity.
